frequency_question: How often does a congressional resolution of disapproval successfully pass both chambers to block a contested executive international agreement?
membership_rule: Includes all formal joint resolutions introduced under privileged statutory review procedures to block major executive foreign agreements or arms sales, excluding resolutions that failed to reach a floor vote due to leadership intervention or lack of privileged status.

cases.name: 2019 Yemen arms sales resolutions of disapproval

coverage_note: 5 major historical showdowns identified where legislative veto or joint resolution of disapproval reached floor votes against executive opposition.
known_gaps: Excludes minor informal resolutions that were withdrawn before floor votes or committee discharge petitions that failed to gather signatures.
skeleton: Statutory review attempts under AECA and similar frameworks across polarized and unified government configurations.
multiplier: 1 successful override/block out of 5 major contested legislative showdowns
validity_reason: Statutory frameworks governing congressional review of international agreements remain stable under the AECA and Atomic Energy Act.
